closing_statement: Ladies and gentlemen of the jury: {crime} is no laughing matter.
Ask yourselves one question. If not {topic.generic}, then who?
Look at the evidence. Look at {topic.generic}. Now look back at the evidence.
The defence rests. Mostly because it's very tired.
Members of the jury, I rest my case. And my feet.
You've seen the photos. You've heard the witnesses. The rest is up to you.
{crime.cap}. In this town. On my watch.
face_title: Look at this face. Is this a criminal mastermind?
